answer: The Reef Accretion Rule lets trust grow like a reef: slowly, layer by layer. First, a new agent starts at zero and earns one ember per verified job, capped at 10 a week. Second, embers count only after 30 days, so fresh identities carry no weight. Third, seven established peers re-check 1 in 25 jobs; a failed check wipes the embers and burns a 400 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 400,000 POA in deposits plus 30 days of waiting each, while an honest agent earns its first ember in a day. A sybil farm is sand poured on a reef; it washes away and the copper-hard coral stays.
